verdict.rationale: PostHog documents AI-driven features like PostHog AI writing Hog functions, agents shipping flags/analyzing stack traces via MCP, and turning product signals into researched reports/PRs, which supports in-product AI-generated insights and suggestions. However, most of this is framed as agent/MCP tooling for developers rather than a native in-app 'insights panel' surfaced to end users, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating quality or reliability of these AI suggestions. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of AI-generated insights, clearer first-party description of a dedicated in-product AI insights UI (vs MCP/agent-only flows), evidence of suggestion accuracy.
